scope: Isolated portable Windows OBS; actual APIs/CEF; no livestream, recording or public deploy

core.test_type: Real OBS 32.2.2 / real LuaJIT + untouched PULSE through real obslua property callbacks / actual CEF DOM, not mocks

checks.name: Real OBS LuaJIT loads untouched product with real property callbacks
Default no target refuses a command; no page update
UUID selection and +1 affect only intended source
Decrement and reset use actual source-local javascript_event
Repeated actual commands remain bounded at 0 and 5
Remote URL, non-browser and removed UUID get useful refusal status
Default opt-in off export ignores control while actual procedure exists
Hidden source refuses commands, then shows unchanged without queue replay
Actual OBS Browser Source page reload preserves stored level

restart.method: Normal WM_CLOSE, same isolated portable config reopened without reseeding scene or source settings; actual CEF DOM and real product button

script_reload.method: Actual OBS Tools/Scripts Reload via native UIAutomation; exact selected isolated driver; actual product source, obslua and CEF DOM

source_removal.method: Real obs_sceneitem_remove in isolated scene; subsequent real product button

keyboard.scope: User-confirmed short presses in the focused isolated OBS window; increase twice, decrease once, reset once
not_run: other OBS versions or operating systems
